newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Daelim in telecom pact with Lockheed.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Daelim in telecom pact with Lockheed.

text.p: South Korea's Daelim Group said on Wednesday it had formed a strategic alliance with Lockheed Martin Corp of the United States to cooperate in the information and telecommunications sector.

A statement from Daelim, the country's leading construction and petrochemical conglomerate, said the partnership would help it gear up to offer systems integration and outsourcing services to government agencies and the banking industry.
It said Daelim Information and Telecommunications Co, a unit of the Daelim Group, had already been in a tie-up with Lockheed Martin's telecommunications unit Formtek Corp.
Daelim has 13 affiliates, including construction and petrochemical firm Daelim Industrial Co.
